systems.name: 4.1 Basic Enemy Controller
systems.notes: Simple pathfinding or direct chase towards player. Enemies react to sound and sight. Stun/stagger mechanics on hit.
tasks: Lose sight and return to patrol
Death fall and fade away (or dissolve)

systems.name: 4.2 Enemy Variety & Bosses
systems.notes: Multiple enemy types: slow zombies, fast crawlers, dogs, lickers. Boss fights with unique patterns and arena lock.
tasks: Enemy data table (HP, speed, damage, model)
Boss arena setup (sealed room, distinct camera)
Drop item or key on defeat

systems.name: 4.3 Audio & Visual Feedback
systems.notes: Growls, footsteps, ambient howls. Splatter effects, dynamic blood decals on walls/floor.
tasks: Blood splatter on death (particle or decal)
